answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, which means paying the quill bond on all of them and exposing each to the ivory slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 3 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the cedar audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. The bill scales 20 fold, not the vote. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
